roadMarkingsEvidence: Google Street View, September2025, Statistica panorama heading270: a continuous longitudinal line toward the southern side of the travel lane and a dashed delimiter toward the northern parking strip. The game coordinates, line widths and dash lengths are photographic estimates, not surveyed measurements. OSM records two lanes and no one-way restriction; existing traffic behavior is unchanged.

treeEvidence: Individual approximate trunk/crown positions digitised from official2020/2026 orthophotos and identifiable frontage images. Two young trees at917.1/925.0 are based on the closer September2025 Street View, because overhead crowns obscure individual trunks. All heights, radii and species are estimated; no generic grid and no photographic vehicles.

crossingEvidence: OSM crossing nodes and July/September2025 Street View confirm the west/east Bucuresti and south Bulgara marked crossings. The northern Bulgara crossing is unmarked; no invented zebra.
axisEvidence: Official Strazi_RM centreline is recorded separately from visible road edges and the existing OSM-based scene. The BUC01 seam at x805 is unchanged (465.4..474.6). A 20m taper widens to the orthophoto-estimated carriageway including existing parking. Midblock carriageway is approximately13.2m; Bulgara extends to z433/506 with approximately14m including parking. Sidewalks follow asymmetric full cadastral fronts. All widths remain estimates. No parked photographic vehicles are modelled.
evidence: Official cadastral geometry supplies no heights/storey counts. All metric elevations, roofs, internal ruin outline, passage clearance, pavement/road widths and vegetation dimensions are estimates. Official address points and parcels are provenance only. The2026 orthophoto layer name is not an exact capture date. Small overlaps in official boundary records are partitioned only in rendered parts; raw official parent outlines remain recorded.
